quests.title: The Cannon Has Ears

dialogue.t: We've been at this for half a day now, and the monsters aren't showing any signs of thinning out...
Maybe I should call for reinforcements?
There's no need to panic. Trust in the cannon and our plainclothes colleague!
Besides, there's an adventurer with a nose for danger and a certain officer who are sure to turn up should we find ourselves in a crisis...

dialogue.sit: What's all this about a crisis?
We got here in time, I hope?

dialogue.t: Wow, here they are... Proto-Boss and his(her) little assistant really have shown up!
Hello, you two. Please allow me to explain the situation...
Why don't you take a breather? I can brief these two.
Hey! Want to have a go on the cannon? Opportunities like this don't roll around often, at least, not since the fleet was destroyed. It'll be a blast from centuries past!
Blowing monsters to smithereens with these specially made projectiles is the perfect way to unwind — and the Gardes will even reward you for it!
Blasting monsters with a massive cannon... That's right up our alley!

dialogue.sit: Is there a particular reason for blowing these monsters up?

dialogue.t: I understand your excitement, Proto-Boss, but we're still on a knife's edge here. Let me fill you in on what's happening.
Recently, a group of workers unexpectedly unearthed some ruins nearby, disturbing the monsters slumbering within...
We Gardes have set up a containment zone to prevent their escape.
Well, I say "containment zone"... At the moment, it's just the two of us and a Melusine agent who happened to be here on holiday... Oh, and our customized cannon, of course!
Eek! That sounds dangerous! Paimon hopes that Melusine agent isn't in any danger...
Don't worry about her. The cannon at the entrance to the ruins is operated remotely — she can keep most of the monsters in check without getting anywhere near them.
She's very reliable, but this operation's dragging on now, and she must be exhausted.
Will you help us out, Proto-Boss? If the situation doesn't improve soon, I'll have to call for reinforcements.
What are you talking about, Chenee? You know how capable our Proto-Boss is — with him(her) in control, my cannon will wipe out those monsters in no time flat!

dialogue.sit: Say no more. I'd love to give this cannon a blast...
I'm willing to help no matter the situation!

dialogue.t: It's not our style to walk away from danger!
Fantastic! We're very grateful for your help.
After our last experiment, I made some adjustments to my invention — I hope you'll find it easy to operate.
*sigh* Now, if only we could get it to aim and fire automatically... What do you think?
That's a great idea! Next time, I can try fitting it with a Gardemek's target identification module! That way, it should be able to operate autonomously.
How clever — you really are a genius!
Hey-ho! Here comes the relief force...
Huh? What are you two doing here?

dialogue.sit: I feel like we've met before...

dialogue.t: Have we met before?
Nothing wrong at all! It's good to see such famously strong heroes here to help!
Back in the unit — and after I returned to the village, too — everyone said you two could take care of anything.
On the other hand, those two over there are reliable enough, but there's something a little... awkward between them.
Human emotions are complicated... I think maybe they could do with a little push.
Forget it. There are more important things to focus on.
Anyway, I have faith in you. The cannon's easy enough to operate. I'm sure you'll have those monsters cleared up in short order.

quests.description: The Gardes are facing an emergency in the south of Fontaine. It appears they need assistance…
